download_unittest_models: download pretrained models used by ParlAI unit tests to the specified datapath directory
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch all unittest model archives including seq2seq and transformer models
check_model_version: check if unittest models version v7.1 are already built before downloading again
download_transformer_models: download transformer ranker and transformer generator pretrained model archives for unit testing
download_memnn_model: download the memnn pretrained model archive used by ParlAI unit tests
